title: Dealer visit plans and test-plan checks
summary: This topic mostly contains procedural statements about planned dealer follow-up, inspections, updates, purchases, or lease timing, with only one clearly positive example tied to test-plan results showing no faults.

positive.summary: The positive review describes completed test procedures that found no faults or needed testing actions.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews are mainly factual statements about customers planning to contact a dealer, schedule inspection or diagnosis, check updates, or consider a later purchase or replacement.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined procedural statements, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic mixes service follow-up plans with future purchase or lease intentions rather than one tightly focused issue.
One positive review includes a fragment stating no test plans were available, which limits how specifically the positive experience can be characterized from the sampled text.
